chapter: Marriage to Eve and the trio years
title: Eve and Mildred's friendly relationship
summary: Eve and Mildred were fond of each other; they visited Mildred's farm with the children, and Norvo praises Eve and tells of losing her five years ago.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: Well a couple of years after we moved to California and came back, I was working at the Embers, here.

And the younger ones were quite young. The baby was six months and Portia's a couple years older and Mark was in first grade, I believe. We used to go up to Mildred's farm. Lot of people say, say to Eve, Aren't you -- how do you feel about that? She said, 'Well I'm sure if Red wanted to be married to Mildred he would.'
Open about this. I think that's why Mildred liked her very much.
No, no. I don't think there was any -- and she was crazy about the children, Mildred was just insane about them.
Well Eve must've felt sorry for Mildred, too. She must've felt sorry about it. Wasn't she?
Well I don't know if she felt sorry, I just think she -- she admired Mildred greatly and --
And -- there was never anything really -- she was a very unusual woman, Eve was.
Lot of her friends, here in New York -- she made a lot of friends.
See, she wasn't show businessy in any way more or less. And we had a nice home and I had a very nice -- and I had a very nice family -- and we were very much in love and we were -- great years.
Course, I lost her five years ago, but way I feel is the way she would've felt that I should appreciate the years that I had. And, --
-- I suppose you can't say why these things ah -- happen -- you just have to accept. The hardest thing in life is learning to accept -- you can't make it happen the way you want it.
No, you can't. It's quite true that --
No, but she knew that I was a musician
that I'd have to go where I'd have to go.
When I was out there working studios and going crazy, when I first went out, she knew that. But she said, I don't think it's worth it. I think you ought to do what you want to do.
Even if you have to go.
